**v1.7.2 couldn't actually update itself. This one can.** I tested v1.7.2, watched it work, and shipped it with a line announcing it was the last release you'd ever need a cable for. Then the first real update tried to install a file 90 KB bigger than the one I'd tested with, and the board rebooted halfway through. The chip's documentation spells out exactly how long it will wait before assuming it has frozen. I did not read the documentation. RTFM applies to the people who write the M too.

This one installs over WiFi from start to finish, tested twice on a real board against squachwatch.com, with the manual open this time.

**Bluetooth updates don't work from this version either. WiFi does.** The reason, and the fix, are in [v1.7.4](https://github.com/skizzophrenic/SquachWatch-CYD/releases/tag/v1.7.4).

**Install this one over USB.** A board on v1.7.2 restarts partway through any update and stays on the version it had. Nothing is lost, but the update never lands. From v1.7.3 on, updates come over the air.

## Why v1.7.2 couldn't update

Before writing a new version, the board cleared the whole spare slot in one go, about 1.6 MB. That kept its memory chip busy for more than five seconds, and five seconds is precisely how long the board's safety watchdog waits before deciding it has frozen and restarting it. It says so right there in the manual. It now clears space a little at a time as the download arrives.

## Straight to your WiFi

UPDATE OVER WIFI joins your saved network without asking. The list of networks only appears the first time, or when the saved one can't be joined.

## A steady download screen

The progress screen redrew the whole display every time the percentage went up, so it flashed about a hundred times. Now only the bar and the numbers change.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: updates over WiFi and Bluetooth restarted the board partway through and never installed
- **Fixed**: the download screen flashed on every percent
- **Changed**: UPDATE OVER WIFI joins the saved network straight away
